_meta.purpose: Deterministic 'how much / when' store (§C.6). RAG must NEVER supply these — doses, splits, durations, Kc, yields live here.

sources.doses_splits: BARC Fertilizer Recommendation Guide (FRG) 2018 — data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0094.txt (T. Aman rice, HYV group, Medium soil-test row).
sources.kc: FAO CROPWAT / FAO-56 crop coefficients by growth stage (standard published reference, not yet re-verified against a locally retrieved copy).

_meta.status: Fertilizer dose, calendar, and stage-duration totals verified against retrieved BARC/BRRI documents (2026-07-24). Per-phenological-stage day split and Kc still `_verify: true` pending a locally retrieved primary source.

calendar._source: BRRI dhan-71 / dhan-93 / dhan-94 variety records — data/raw/brri_varieties/{brri-dhan-71,brri-dhan-93,brri-dhan-94}.json

sowing_window._note: nursery sowing (MM-DD); BRRI dhan-71 nursery 5–15 July

harvest_window._note: BRRI dhan-71 harvest 1–15 Nov; dhan-93/94 harvest Nov–Dec

stage_durations_days._source: Total field duration verified: BRRI dhan-71 114–117 days (post-transplant to harvest), BRRI dhan-93/94 137–138 days (sowing to harvest). Per-stage breakdown below is an engineering estimate consistent with that verified total, not itself line-cited.

fertilizer._source: BARC FRG-2018, RICE (T. Aman rice), HYV group incl. BR4/BR10/BR11/BR22/BR23/BRRI dhan30-54/hybrid dhan4/Binadhan-4/7/8, Yield Goal 5.0±0.5 t/ha, Medium soil-test-interpretation row — data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0094.txt
fertilizer.assumption: Dose is the midpoint of BARC's 'Medium' soil-test-interpretation range (N 31-60, P 6-10, K 21-40, S 5-8 kg/ha) — the practical default when a farmer's specific soil-test level is unknown.

carriers._note: Engine converts nutrient kg → product kg (urea ~46% N, TSP ~46% P2O5, MoP ~60% K2O, gypsum ~18% S). Do the conversion in financial.engine, not here.

fertilizer.method_of_application: BARC FRG-2018 p.94: N in three equal splits (basal/immediately after seedling establishment, early tillering, 5-7 days before panicle initiation); P/K/S/Zn fully basal at final land preparation (coarse-textured soils may split K — not modeled here).

organic_alternatives._source: BARC FRG-2018 §5.7/6.3 (data/raw/barc_frg_2018/page_0063.txt, page_0071.txt): incorporating 12-15 t/ha green dhaincha biomass reduces T. Aman N requirement by 25-30 kg/ha.

cow_dung.note: well-decomposed; apply during land prep; substitutes part of N/P/K

dhaincha_green_manure.note: incorporate within a week before T. Aman transplanting

kc_by_stage._source: FAO-56 / CROPWAT (rice) — standard published reference; not yet re-verified against a locally retrieved copy

base_yield_kg_per_ha._source: Chanda et al. 2019 (Aman HYV ~3.0 t/ha) — a conservative farmer-average estimate; BRRI variety-trial yields for dhan-71/93/94 run 5-6 t/ha (research-station potential, not farmer average)
